text:
The systematic review reports observational evidence on contextual factors (e.g., school‑based health centers, urban residence, socioeconomic status, policy instruments) that are associated with mental‑health service use among children and adolescents. It does not propose, test, or support a multi‑modal predictive modeling framework such as the “Contextual Resilience and Access Prediction (CRAP) Framework” that includes graph convolutional neural networks, Bayesian causal inference, or spatio‑temporal regression. Consequently, the study’s evidence does not back this candidate hypothesis.

VERDICT: REJECT
